name: Worlds in Miniature
summary: A hand-held miniature of a virtual environment provides linked proxies for selecting and manipulating objects and changing viewpoint.
howItWorks: Hold a small copy of the scene in one hand and touch or grab an object in the copy with the other hand; the full-size object is selected.
